sector_dated_note: GICS sector in the last constituents snapshot on or before the window end; before 2012-12-27 the first snapshot is used (not truly dated). Source: datasets/s-and-p-500-companies.
encoding: corr/<year>.json rho_x1000 is the upper triangle (i<j, row by row) of the correlation matrix in the order of tickers, as round(1000*rho)
provenance: Yahoo Finance daily closes (yfinance export, March 2025), split- and dividend-adjusted; survivor panel of 203 continuous S&P 500 members 2003-2024; simple returns; 252-day windows. No prices are included.
